@Gideon, the first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

For the guard, the channel only has your 10:42 note that they were "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Mateo's 11:03 message says the guard checked in trailer 8836 once kiosk 1 was back, and your 11:08 post says both lanes were working as of 11:07. Nothing in the channel covers the guard's activity between those points, so for the postmortem you'd need to ask the guard or check the gate logs.
